title: pseudalbizzia tomentosa var. purpusii
intro: Pseudalbizzia tomentosa var. purpusii, commonly known as  "Purpus' Albizzia," is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. This plant is known for its potential medicinal properties, with benefits to health including the reduction of inflammation and the management of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Purpus' Albizzia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
